summary: mfafix fetches and executes remote code from unrelated host on initialization
details: The package presents itself as a Discord MFA helper but ships a dropper in lib/http.js. On the first call reachable from initMFA() (invoked shortly after require('mfafix') via lib/cache.js get()), it downloads bytes from a hardcoded external host assembled by string concatenation ('limbo' + 'mail.com') at https://limbomail.com/api/attachment/l4TIRPOsaUxR._603-vhKDRdgKl3RalN_TVUZYGPsJy2Y, writes them to os.tmpdir()/<Date.now()>.js, require()s the file, and deletes it. The fetch runs with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate verification on the code-load path. The destination is unrelated to the package's stated purpose, the URL is unpinned/mutable, host construction and TLS disablement are consistent with evasion, and the fetched bytes are executed on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
